title: Turn Grocery Shopping Into Cooperation | Parenting Rewind
description:
A bored six-year-old can find trouble in every supermarket aisle. A practical pause-and-rewind response for parents.

General parenting education; every child and family is different.
audience_intent: Adults and parents; not directed to children
education_scope: General parenting education only; not personalised therapy, diagnosis, or medical advice.

narration.transcript: A bored six-year-old can find trouble in every supermarket aisle. Correcting every touch keeps both of you focused on what is going wrong. Before reacting, pause for one breath so the next words can be short, clear, and useful. Give a real job before problems start: Please find the oats and place them gently in the trolley. One age-fitting responsibility and specific praise can create more cooperation than constant policing.

source.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
source.title: Tips for Praise, Imitation, and Description

claim_limits: The suggested wording is an example, not a guarantee.
Families should adapt expectations to age, development, safety and individual needs.
